title: Sub-calls listed under usage.iterations, re-logged with growth
policy: P11 (assumption, unverified against Claude Code): the top-level usage covers the main model; iterations of another model are extra operations; iterations of type "message" or of the main model are already in the top-level usage.
derivation: Haiku 4.5 main [10, 10]; claude-test-1 sub-call [30, 3] growing to [30, 7] in the re-log. 57 tokens, 2 operations. Known cost: Haiku 10 x $1/M + 10 x $5/M = $0.00006; the sub-call is unpriced, so partial.
